episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.summary: Griffin Campbell and his family move to a new town and take ownership of an abandoned hotel in hopes of restoring it back to the lively vacation destination it once was.

episodes.title: Somewhere in Time
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper realize they've time traveled to before Savannah's disappearance. When they go back again, they think they see Savannah getting taken into the woods.

episodes.title: Straight Outta Time
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper learn the camp dance is coming up, and that is the day Savannah went missing! Later, Harper meets Jess, and learns her mom did go to camp and hated Savannah!

episodes.title: Time to Face the Music
episodes.summary: Harper asks Griffin to meet her at the portal after school, but, when Griffin gets home, he discovers his Grandfather has arrived for a visit.

episodes.title: Parsley, Sage, Rosemary and Time
episodes.summary: Ben is upset by the flurry of news reports marking the thirtieth anniversary of Savannah's disappearance, while Zoey and Wyatt see it as the perfect opportunity to finally capture her ghost on tape.

episodes.title: Time Warped
episodes.summary: Young Jess dares Savannah to spend the night in The Tremont basement with real ghosts. Young Ben comes to Savannah's defense. Young Jess storms off and wishes Savannah gone.

episodes.title: Long Time Gone
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper sneak back through the portal to find a search party looking for Savannah; police officers begin their questioning.

episodes.title: If I Could Turn Back Time
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper realise that Savannah could have found the portal and travelled back in time, too; together, they go back in time another 30 years to 1960.

episodes.title: As Time Goes By
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper use the old radio in the hidden room to lead them back to Savannah.

episodes.title: No Time Like the Present
episodes.summary: Griffin and Harper set the dial on the radio to take them back in time where they hope to find Savannah and they are shocked by what they uncover.

episodes.title: Time After Time
episodes.summary: Harper goes back in time and finds her dad who takes her on a ride down memory lane.

episodes.title: Only Time Will Tell
episodes.summary: Griffin, Savannah and Harper find themselves face to face with Harper's carbon copy, Daisy, and the Tremont ghost sends Harper and Griffin an important message.

episodes.title: No Time to Waste
episodes.summary: Harper pretends to be Daisy to learn her family's secrets, and Topher stumbles upon the hidden bunker.

episodes.title: Time Out
episodes.summary: Griffin frantically searches for the missing crystal and helps a panicking Daisy to navigate her modern surroundings; meanwhile, Harper has a cryptic vision at the springs.

episodes.title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
episodes.summary: Young Sam secretly watches Harper search for the hatch in the dead of the night, and Elijah receives a visit from a judge with a life-altering offer.

episodes.title: It's About Time
episodes.summary: When Sam can't get his Time Machine to work, Savannah vows to help him; meanwhile, Griffin tells Daisy that he thinks Topher is hiding something and enlists her to find answers.

episodes.title: Crunch Time
episodes.summary: The Tremonts were duped by the Judge and have 48 hours to vacate their land. Meanwhile, when Griffin and Daisy rush towards the portal with the crystal, everything goes black!

episodes.title: Check-out Time
episodes.summary: Harper returns home and fills Griffin in on the deed, stolen land, and her visions of a fire. After Sam disappears, Savannah finds a note saying that he's travelled to the future.

episodes.title: Time Is Not On Our Side
episodes.summary: The Campbell's and the Dunn's prepare for the Tremont's Grand Re-opening! Harper and Griffin realize that the crystal is cracking which may prevent the Time Machine from working.

episodes.title: Time Won't Let Me
episodes.summary: Griffin, stuck in the future, learns the ghost ruins their lives. Harper and Savannah try bringing him back to the present.

episodes.title: Time in a Crystal
episodes.summary: Harper and Savannah retrieve Griffin from the future. Sam and Griffin face the grimmest truth, Topher is in a coma in 2024. The twins and Topher almost catch Savannah's "ghost."

episodes.title: Closing Time
episodes.summary: The twins arrive in the past and find Savannah. Griffin and Harper realize they need to go back to 1947 just as Ben makes the bunker off-limits.

episodes.title: Bad Judge of Time
episodes.summary: The kids learn the ghost has been listening to them and is changing up his malevolent plans.

episodes.title: Time Waits for No One
episodes.summary: In 1947, Harper and Griffin meet Ruby. Sarah becomes increasingly freaked out by the ghost.

episodes.title: Time Reveals All
episodes.summary: Returning to the past, Griffin and Harper watch a murder unfold. The twins and Topher go to an unknowingly familiar someone for help.

episodes.title: Scream Time
episodes.summary: It's time to get rid of the ghost.

episodes.title: Nick of Time
episodes.summary: The ghost and future will be saved.
